inputs.text: This flare-up between the US, Israel, and Iran is sending oil prices skyrocketing and squeezing fuel costs right here in India. The government's move to cut excise duties and keep petrol and diesel from jumping is nothing but reckless short-term interference that bleeds away national revenue and sets the stage for worse inflation later. Our heavy dependence on foreign crude imports has left the country exposed to these endless overseas conflicts, and it's time we stopped pretending global meddling can fix what only real national strength can. We should be putting energy self-reliance and sovereignty first, along with the old-fashioned values of prudence, personal responsibility, and family security that built stable societies in the first place, instead of chaining ourselves to unstable foreign powers that threaten our economic order and the future of our households.
